items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I had a band -- at this point, it was near the end of the Second Herd. And Shadow Wilson was on drums

ctx.x: So they snuck on back to New York, and we finished out the week. And I brought in to cope with this Shelley Mann situation -- that's when Shelley Mann came in the band. So they came in for a week, and then it turned out Shadow got zonked out and so Shelley stayed.
So did the other people ever come back then?
